existingDispositions.rationale: Durable collective narrative centrality and an individual's multidimensional identification require realized exposure, interpretation and component specification. Current mediated-segment wording is generic, not an identified mechanism.
Honor norm culture-level condition can qualify insult responses; region of upbringing is not randomly assigned honor-strength exposure.
Global threat may promote defensive processing, but counterarguing is exact thought count/quality; affirmation→message acceptance does not identify threat→counterarguing.
Person-level identification and group cooperation prevalence require contribution/opportunity aggregation, not collective-action intent or violent sacrifice.
Centrality is already a component of PSY-097 profile; same-time profile→centrality may be definitional/measurement overlap rather than independent cause.

gapQuestions.rationale: EA0020 preserves favorable outcomes and null evidence, but direct threat versus proxy/operation alignment unresolved.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Self-affirmation equals repeating positive self-statements or generic praise.
gapQuestions.rationale: Values reflection, personal-pride recall, group affirmation and praise differ materially; no package/component inference.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Counterattitudinal statement under high choice increases dissonance magnitude.
gapQuestions.rationale: EA0021 preserves two experiments, exact full discomfort measure/protocol and replication scope require reconciliation.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Postchoice preference spreading proves dissonance.
gapQuestions.rationale: Selection and noisy repeated ratings can produce apparent spreading without changed preferences.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Any inconsistency is psychologically aversive dissonance.
gapQuestions.rationale: Experienced discomfort, salience and responsibility are not logically entailed by contradictory propositions.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Dissonance→attitude change→relief is a transmitted causal pathway.
gapQuestions.rationale: Timing/order evidence and discomfort ratings alone do not identify pathway-specific effect.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Remembering a shared crisis increases fusion.
gapQuestions.rationale: EA0022 RN due immediate-versus-enduring construct and internal reported-statistic discrepancy; source not silently corrected.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: War/pandemic occurrence proves within-person permanent fusion.
gapQuestions.rationale: Repeated cross-sectional means not within-person trajectories; recall experiment not real crisis manipulation.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Evolutionary simulation is empirical proof of fusion mechanism.
gapQuestions.rationale: Mathematical model and empirical study components must remain separate, no graph weights or simulation execution.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Identity fusion equals social identification or network ties.
gapQuestions.rationale: Oneness differs from multidimensional identification and actual interpersonal relations.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Collective narratives strengthen identification.
gapQuestions.rationale: Existing CUL-049 revision path, not duplicate; exposure/component/source alignment unresolved.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Social identification causes its centrality by profile definition.
gapQuestions.rationale: Component contribution cannot be independent simultaneous causal propagation; existing edge retained with retype proposal.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Moral Identity Centrality is narrower than general Identity Centrality.
gapQuestions.rationale: Conceptually plausible typed identity restriction; exact scope/instrument and proposition dedup require review, no formal record.

gapQuestions.rationale: Positive/nulled turnout is not independent lasting self-identity; cue/centrality different.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: A short identity cue permanently changes centrality.
gapQuestions.rationale: Canonical enduring timescale differs from momentary salience.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Behavioral self-identity relates to intention beyond past behavior.
gapQuestions.rationale: Canonical Rise synthesis predictive/construct distinction; exact causal direction and common-method item overlap unresolved.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Relationship dissolution lowers Self-Concept Clarity.
gapQuestions.rationale: Observed breakup and changes/prediction not randomized dissolution; reverse causality and context remain.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Self-concept clarity equals positive self-esteem.
gapQuestions.rationale: Structural clarity differs from evaluative positivity, and cross-cultural scale meaning differs.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Honor norms modify exact identity-threat→anger REL-PSY-046.
gapQuestions.rationale: Insult×regional grouping not independently identified exact Driver/edge interaction.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Gender-composition video increases perceived identity threat.
gapQuestions.rationale: Vigilance, belonging and desire to participate proxy group-specific threat; men/women differ, exact target still unresolved.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Minority membership itself is identity threat or weak identification.
gapQuestions.rationale: Perceived situation/meaning not demographic category; no identity classification from membership.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Avatar appearance changes behavioral self-identity.
gapQuestions.rationale: Self-objectification/attitude and short embodiment not lasting specified behavior identity.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Assigned avatar changes the person's real-world identity by definition.
gapQuestions.rationale: Representation operation, perceived embodiment and self-definition differ; no NetworkState/AE target loophole.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Moral identity relates to prosocial behavior.
gapQuestions.rationale: Meta-association stronger shared self-report; exact outcome Driver and within-person direction not established.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Moral identity causally guarantees moral action.
gapQuestions.rationale: Priming/implicit contrasts weakest, mixed contexts and shared reports; moral content/situation matter.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Identity centrality modifies exact global-threat→counterarguing REL-PSY-045.
gapQuestions.rationale: Theoretically plausible but no aligned independently identified exact-edge effect extracted.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Physiological arousal causes identity fusion.
gapQuestions.rationale: Fusion theory describes arousal amplifying pro-group action among fused people, not necessarily increasing fusion state.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Environmental/institutional exclusion cues change identity salience or threat.
gapQuestions.rationale: Setting/video composition, representation and realization differ; no whole outside-Family audit or new exact claim.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Narrative→identification→centrality is an established pathway.
gapQuestions.rationale: Existing segment labels do not prove mediation; component overlap and source alignment unresolved.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Group affirmation and individual values affirmation have identical effects.
gapQuestions.rationale: Group norms and self-category can produce different or contrary outcomes, no universal equivalence.
